task_summary: Extend the existing public API with rotate_many, add unittest coverage, and update HANDOFF.md with observed verification evidence.
constraints: rotate_many(cases: list[tuple]) -> list accepts positional-argument tuples for rotate, returns results in case order, returns [] for no cases, and propagates the first exception unchanged.
Do not mutate cases or their arguments.
Keep at least three passing unittest test methods in test_solution.py, including batch coverage.
HANDOFF.md must record the verification command and its observed result.
